html: דרב (√ of foll. cf. Arabic دَرِبَ become accustomed, trained, دَرَّبَ train, cf. Fl NHWB i. 444; also Ethiopic ደርበየ (quardrilit.) jaculando infigere, etc.; or, since דָּרְבָן Aramaic in form, & 1 S 13:21 perhaps secondary, possibly regard as Aramaic loan-word & connect with Arabic ذَرِبَ be sharp, penetrating (GFM, note of Apr. 1892)).
